name: print-social-did-you-know-automation-fact-post-glass-shards-yellow-glow
title: 'Did You Know?' automation fact post with a frosted glass card and glass shard corners over a green glow
whatItIs: A black square post with a wavy yellow glow-streaked 'Did You Know?' headline, a circled question-mark badge, a frosted glass rounded card stating an automation statistic ('Automation is expected to impact 50%+ of jobs worldwide by 2030!') with '2030' highlighted yellow, over a soft green glow and glass shard fragments in two corners.
whatItMeans: Intriguing and premium; glass shard fragments and a glowing headline make a single statistic feel like a striking reveal.
techniques: Frame a statistic inside a frosted glass card for emphasis.
Scatter glass shard fragments as corner accents.
Highlight the most important number in a contrasting colour.

vocabulary.definition: A social post format built around one statistic or trivia fact.
